verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows run automatically once attached to scheduling links. They support multi-action meeting-lifecycle messages and reminders with configurable timing, and Zapier-triggered no-code automations can sync a CRM or create to-dos. Webhooks add event-driven background integrations. Missing for 10: detailed docs on available triggers and execution behavior, any AI- or agent-driven automation, clarity on whether CRM and project-management actions are native or need Zapier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
